trip: Live over-the-air sport in Malta, 13–19 Oct 2026 (Kalshi-relevant: EPL, soccer, NFL etc.)

items.name: Malta DAB+ multiplex (block 6A, 181.936 MHz)
items.address: Transmitters: Ġargħur (10 kW) and Żebbuġ, Gozo
items.description: Malta's national DAB+ ensemble (allotment MLT00017, on air since July 2008) carries ~20 stations including BBC World Service, talkSPORT, Radju Malta and Campus FM. A DAB+ radio (or DAB+ app/stream as fallback) receives it anywhere on the islands.
items.notes: Station list and transmitter data from radioinmalta.com (dedicated Malta radio directory); Radju Malta's DAB+ carriage on block 6A corroborated by Wikipedia (181.936 MHz). US cars/receivers have HD Radio, not DAB+ — bring or buy a DAB+ set.

items.name: BBC World Service — DAB+ in Malta
items.address: DAB+ block 6A (station ID C001, 32 kbps HE-AACv2)
items.description: BBC World Service broadcasts on Malta's DAB+ multiplex — the carrier of Sportsworld live Premier League commentary at weekends, plus Sport Today weeknights and World Service news.
items.notes: Carriage verified on radioinmalta.com stations + 6A lists. This is the verified route to live English-language PL radio in Malta.

items.name: talkSPORT — DAB+ in Malta (labelled 'Sports Channel')
items.description: The UK's biggest sports-talk station carries exclusive live Premier League commentary (GameDay Saturdays, plus Friday/Monday night picks), EFL, and boxing — listed on Malta's DAB+ line-up as 'Sports Channel'. talkSPORT 2 (stream/sibling) adds NFL and cricket.
items.notes: Malta carriage per radioinmalta.com. talkSPORT's UK online stream is geo-restricted for some rights; the Malta DAB+ carriage is an over-the-air feed — rights window for a given match should be confirmed on the day (schedule at talksport.com).

items.name: BBC World Service — Sportsworld (live PL at weekends)
items.address: BBC World Service — DAB+ 6A in Malta
items.hours: Weekends during the football season; this week (10–11 Oct 2026): Sat from 15:06 Malta (14:06 BST) and Sun from 16:06 Malta (15:06 BST) — pattern repeats; the 17–18 Oct schedule publishes ≈ 7 days out
items.description: 'Live sporting action — including the English Premier League': Sportsworld is the BBC's global live-sport window and the verified, dated English-language PL radio slot available in Malta. This week's published schedule shows the recurring Saturday & Sunday afternoon Malta-time windows; expect the same on 17–18 Oct.
items.notes: Schedule for 10–11 Oct 2026 verified via UKRadioLive's BBC WS listing (they mirror the BBC schedule; BBC's own /programmes pages 404'd at last check). Exact 17–18 Oct hours & commentary pick: RE-CHECK T-7 (bbc.co.uk/schedules or BBC Sounds). Malta time = BST+1 until clocks change 25 Oct.

items.name: talkSPORT GameDay (Saturday PL/EFL commentary)
items.hours: Saturdays: GameDay Exclusive ~12:30–14:30 BST pick, GameDay Live 14:30, Phone-In 17:30, Kick Off evening — current-week pattern (9–12 Oct 2026)
items.description: 'Saturday is GameDay — live and exclusive commentary from the Premier League and EFL.' talkSPORT holds exclusive UK radio rights to a large PL/EFL slate; one big match gets full exclusive commentary, the rest get goal-round coverage. Mon/Fri night 'Kick Off' carries the live night match.
items.notes: Current-week pattern verified (Arsenal v Leeds GameDay Exclusive 10 Oct; Coventry v Newcastle Kick Off 12 Oct). Which match gets GameDay on 17 Oct is published midweek — check talksport.com T-3.

items.name: Premier League MW8 — the trip-weekend slate (Malta times)
items.hours: Sat 17 Oct: 13:30 Everton–Chelsea; 16:00 Brentford–Liverpool / Fulham–Hull / Man City–Ipswich; 18:30 Newcastle–Aston Villa. Sun 18 Oct: 15:00 Bournemouth–Sunderland / Brighton–Palace / Leeds–Man Utd; 17:30 Nott'm Forest–Arsenal. Mon 19 Oct: 21:00 Spurs–Coventry (air time may slip past checkout)
items.description: Full MW8 fixture list from the Premier League's official amendments (17 Aug 2026). Times converted to Malta (CEST = UK+1). At least one Saturday and one Sunday match will be on BBC WS Sportsworld; talkSPORT has exclusive radio on more; the rest run as goal services.
items.notes: Kick-offs confirmed by premierleague.com (all 15:00 BST unless listed; TNT/Sky picks named). Conversion: BST+1 = Malta. Radio rights per match: BBC 5 Live holds 209 live commentaries/season (bbc.com/sport 8 Oct 2026) but 5 Live is NOT on Malta DAB+ — in Malta listen via BBC WS Sportsworld / talkSPORT / BBC Sounds (geo-limited).

items.name: BBC Radio 5 Live & BBC Sounds (stream fallback)
items.description: The most comprehensive PL radio commentary (209 live matches this season per BBC). Caveat: live PL on BBC Sounds is licensed for UK listeners; from Malta many commentaries are blocked ('UK only' labels on programme pages) — the DAB+ Sportsworld feed is the legal over-the-air alternative.
items.notes: BBC article 8 Oct 2026 confirms the 209-match slate and 'UK only' rights flags appear on individual programme pages (e.g. Newcastle–Aston Villa 17 Oct tagged UK only).

items.name: Radio Sportiva & Rai Radio 1 — Italian-language sport on DAB+
items.description: Radio Sportiva (sports format) and Rai Radio 1 ('news, sports, talk') both appear on Malta's DAB+ line-up — Italian-language live sport (Serie A, some UEFA) as a backup band of coverage.
items.notes: Carriage per radioinmalta.com. Programme detail not independently verified — treat as 'likely available', check schedules in Italian.

items.name: Radju Malta — 93.7 FM / 999 kHz AM / DAB+
items.address: 93.7 FM · 999 kHz medium wave · DAB+ block 6A
items.description: Malta's public generalist station (PBS) — Maltese-language news, talk and occasional local sport (e.g. Maltese football); the only AM (MW) station on the dial. Useful as the local-sport flavour and as an AM-band sanity check for your receiver.
items.notes: Frequencies corroborated by radioinmalta.com and Wikipedia. Campus FM (103.7 FM) simulcasts BBC WS/Classic FM (UK) at times per radioinmalta — another BBC-adjacent fallback.

items.name: Campus FM 103.7
items.description: University of Malta station — 'simulcasts BBC World Service and Classic FM (UK) at times' per the Malta radio directory; occasionally picks up BBC sport windows when the main WS feed is otherwise busy.
items.notes: Simulcast claim from radioinmalta.com listing only — verify on the day.

items.name: NFL (Kalshi-relevant) — Week 6/7 on talkSPORT 2 pattern
items.address: talkSPORT 2 (stream; DAB+ carriage of talkSPORT 2 in Malta unverified)
items.hours: US games run Sun/Mon evening–night Malta time (18:00–04:00 CEST)
items.description: talkSPORT 2's current-week pattern (10–11 Oct) carried NFL London Live (Eagles–Jaguars) and NFL Live (Vikings–Saints) as exclusive commentary, plus SA–AUS Test cricket. Week 7 (18–19 Oct) games fall Sunday/Monday Malta nights — the likely radio window for NFL while in Malta.
items.notes: talkSPORT 2 is a UK stream station; whether Malta's DAB+ carries talkSPORT 2 (vs only talkSPORT) is UNVERIFIED — the radioinmalta list shows talkSPORT only. Week 7 specific picks published midweek. For Kalshi, note NFL/MLB markets trade on US schedules — verify Kalshi access rules below before trading.

items.name: Kalshi availability from Malta
items.description: Malta is NOT on Kalshi's restricted-jurisdiction list — the Member Agreement dated 21 Sep 2026 names 55 restricted jurisdictions (incl. UK, France, Italy, Canada, Ireland, Switzerland, Portugal, Poland, Hungary…) and Malta is not among them; Kalshi reports availability in 140+ countries. You can trade from Malta; you cannot trade during UK/Italy/France layovers.
items.notes: Secondary aggregation of Kalshi's Member Agreement (dated 21 Sep 2026) + Finextra/Apr-2026 country availability page. Kalshi may amend unilaterally — screenshot kalshi.com/legal + help centre before flying. Not financial advice. Polymarket also lists Malta as available.

items.name: UEFA Champions/Europa League midweek (13–15 Oct)
items.hours: UCL Tue 13 & Wed 14 Oct (21:00 CEST); UEL Thu 15 Oct (18:45/21:00 CEST)
items.description: Your arrival week has UCL MD3 (e.g. Aston Villa–Fenerbahçe on 14 Oct) and Europa League on 15 Oct. BBC 5 Live carries selected UCL commentaries (UK-only online); Sportsworld sometimes opens midweek windows; Radio Sportiva/Rai 1 cover Italian clubs — the Malta DAB+ options for midweek UEFA are thinner than for EPL.
items.notes: Fixture example (Villa–Fenerbahçe 14 Oct 20:00 UK) via BBC Radio WM episode guide; full MD3 lists at uefa.com. Radio coverage per-match not confirmed — plan on TV/stream for UCL.

items.name: What listening device to bring
items.price_range: Portable DAB+ radios ≈ €25–60 locally (Unieuro/Scan/local electronics) or $30–70 online
items.description: US AM/FM radios work for Malta FM (88–108) and AM 999 kHz, but NOT for DAB+ — where BBC WS and talkSPORT live. Bring a compact DAB+/FM portable (or buy in Malta), or use the station's internet stream as backup in the hotel.
items.notes: US cars use HD Radio, not DAB+ (per US receiver standards) — irrelevant here unless renting a car. Hotel Wi-Fi + station apps (BBC Sounds geo-flags aside) is the zero-carry fallback.
